no-unused-params._justification: main.bicep declares every manifest input (contract §6 parity); inputs consumed only by scripts (tenant_id, key_vault_id, secret_name_prefix, demo_user_*) are intentionally unused in IaC.

use-recent-api-versions._justification: Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings 2021-05-01-preview is the only version with categoryGroup (allLogs); the linter only offers 2016-09-01. Host pools use a preview API on purpose (user-assigned identity); both are recorded in design/shared/verification-log.md.
